'''pointy-eared green dude Red Uniform Ral-Ops''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[pointy-eared green dude]]
* '''Published:''' 9 October 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif|label=Ralltiir Operations}}
* '''Strategy:''' Ralltiir Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 ROps dude DS 2003 RedUnifo.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck, IMO, has a good mix of land and space.  I've wanted to incorporate guards in a dark side deck for the longest time.  What do you guys think?

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

First of all, I know I need some changes in this deck.  I could use some better starting effects, to begin with.  I used to use Imperial Arrest Order, but I traded that to a new friend who was learning the game.  Plus, I'd like to go space/ground with this deck.  I need some Force Lightnings so that the Emperor can whip some @$$.  I think my space is strong enough, but I did think about dropping some of Saber Squadron for some ZiMH and company.  And I like most of my interrupt/effect choices, but I'm thinking that could be better, too.

I'm going to keep the Royal Guards in the deck...no questions asked.  However, is there a quick way to pull the Emperor?  And my activation looks a little tight right now, and I really don't want to be choked.  I like the idea that I can pull Vader early, but other than that, I know that this deck can be A LOT better.  :S

I do have a strategy, but I'd rather not divulge, simply because I want to change it.  (y)  You guys got some suggestions?  I would like to stay classic, but open suggestions are welcome {aka challenger ;) }.  Thanks guys!

PS  I can't go speeders, so please don't suggest that.  If it's possible, answer this:  How can I keep Guards and be effective?
